resources.title: Facts & Figures - University of Colorado Colorado Springs

paragraphs: To finance their educations, UCCS students borrow, on average, $16,780, one-third less than the national average
UCCS students repay their federal student loans. The UCCS student loan default rate, the best in Colorado, is 2.9% compared to a national rate of 13.7%
